summary: Isolated the one link the executed raft-layer account leaves source-based: the client-visible outcome of a discarded read context. Sources show node.read arms no timer of its own, processReadyToRead only supplies indexes when ReadyToReads arrive, and completion therefore depends on pendingReadIndex.applied/gc marking the request as RequestTimeout once its deadline passes, driven by event-loop iterations that LocalTick batches also trigger, including quiesced ticks. Registered this as its own unresolved question and gap asking whether any state prevents applied/gc from running, with defect_claim null and the node-liveness boundary recorded as counterevidence. No execution requested this turn.
